title: Holes and Slots for Metal Bone Plates, Part 1: Corresponding to Screws with Asymmetrical Thread and Spherical Under-Surfaces
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11567 (PART 1)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Holes and Slots for Metal Bone Plates, Part 1: Corresponding to Screws with Asymmetrical Thread and Spherical Under-Surfaces.
clause_3_terminology: Holes and Slots for Metal Bone Plates
Part 1: Corresponding to Screws with Asymmetrical Thread and Spherical Under

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
